description.value:
Vacuum Sphere. You fire a number of compressed-air bullets equal to your spellcasting modifier (minimum 1). Each is treated as a single ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 feet, dealing 3d6 slashing damage on a hit. If multiple bullets hit the same target, each after the first deals 1 less damage per die (minimum 1).

Vacuum Sphere bypasses the first 5 feet of cover thanks to the bullets' precise trajectory.

Heightened (+2) Damage per bullet increases by 1d6.
